evidence.reason: The finding alleges that when the drain expires, a failure in the durable_write of the expired-drain record (`{"polls": polls, "drained": False, "deadline_s": ...}`) prevents FailStop from being raised, letting recover() restart triggers while the run is live. The history between target and tip contains commit a0ae1d2, whose subject is exactly "fix-deploy-runbook-keep-FailStop-when-the-drain-diagnostic-write-fails" (crq-backfill-00f8ade...), i.e. it keeps FailStop on the drain diagnostic write failure. At the tip the expired-drain write now appears at line 876 (content_search), consistent with the block having been reworked. This directly implements the requested behavior, so the defect is repaired rather than outstanding.
